description: Unit test class for BackgroundSyncActor in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.thingsearch.updater.actors package. The test verifies the behavior of the BackgroundSyncActor, including synchronization of things, health reporting, and stream failure handling.

classes.name: BackgroundSyncActorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the BackgroundSyncActor, containing multiple test cases to verify synchronization logic, health reporting, and stream failure handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem and test probes before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: synchronizesThings
methods.description: Test case verifying normal synchronization flow of the BackgroundSyncActor.

methods.name: providesHealthWarningWhenSyncStreamFails
methods.description: Test case verifying that the actor reports a health warning when the stream fails.

methods.name: providesHealthWarningWhenSameThingIsSynchronizedTwice
methods.description: Test case verifying health warnings when the same thing is synchronized twice with different revisions.

methods.name: staysHealthyWhenSameThingIsSynchronizedWithOtherRevision
methods.description: Test case confirming that the actor remains healthy when synchronized with different revisions.

methods.name: thenCreateBackgroundSyncActor
methods.description: Helper to create an instance of the BackgroundSyncActor under test.

methods.name: expectSyncActorToStartStreaming
methods.description: Helper to expect the actor to initiate streaming.

methods.name: thenRespondWithFailingPersistedThingsStream
methods.description: Simulates a failure in the streaming response.

methods.name: thenRespondWithPersistedThingsStream
methods.description: Provides a stream of persisted things as response.

methods.name: expectSyncActorToRequestThingUpdatesInSearch
methods.description: Verifies that the actor requests updates for specific entities.

methods.name: expectSyncActorToBeUpAndHealthy
methods.description: Checks that the actor reports healthy status with info level messages.

methods.name: expectSyncActorToBeUpWithWarning
methods.description: Checks that the actor reports healthy status with warning messages.

methods.name: syncActorShouldHaveHealth
methods.description: Reusable check for the health status and detail messages of the actor.

methods.description: Helper to set the search persistence mock to return certain metadata.
